mapper.select: select a.goods_id AS goodsId, a.goods_name AS goodsName, a.goods_image AS goodsImage, c.goods_spec AS goodsSpec, c.common_id AS commonId, a.goods_price AS goodsPrice, b.order_goods_num AS orderGoodsNum, b.order_goods_payment_amount - b.shipping_fee AS orderGoodsAmount, b.order_goods_returnnum AS orderRefundNum, b.goods_return_status as goodsReturnStatus, b.goods_refund_status as goodsRefundStatus, b.total_goods_shipping_fee as shippingFee, a.return_price as returnPrice FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission a LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods b ON a.order_id = b.order_id and a.goods_id = b.goods_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base c ON a.goods_id = c.goods_id where a.order_id = #{orderId}

select oc.goods_id AS goodsId, gc.common_name AS commonName, gb.goods_image AS goodsImage, gb.goods_spec AS goodsSpec, gc.cat_name AS catName, gb.common_id AS commonId, gc.common_state AS commonState, gc.common_stock AS commonStock, gc.common_image AS commonImage, sfgi.one_tg_rate AS oneTgRate, sfgi.two_tg_rate as twoTgRate, sfgi.fx_rate as fxRate, sb.shop_name as shopName FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb ON gb.goods_id = oc.goods_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gc.common_id = gb.common_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.business}hou_shop_fx_goods_info sfgi ON sfgi.common_id = gb.common_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON sb.supplier_shop_id = gb.shop_id where oc.share_user_id = #{param.userId}
and gb.goods_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.goodsName},'%')
and gc.common_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.commonName},'%')
and gc.common_id like CONCAT('%',#{param.commonId},'%')
and sb.shop_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.shopName},'%')
group by gc.common_id

select count(distinct oc.order_id) as orderCount, sum(IF(oc.share_user_id = #{param.userId}, oc.fx_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_one_user_id = #{param.userId}, oc.one_tg_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_two_user_id = #{param.userId}, oc.two_tg_commission, 0)) as estimatedCommission, oc.goods_id AS goodsId, gc.common_name AS commonName, gc.common_price AS commonPrice, gb.goods_price AS goodsPrice, gb.goods_image AS goodsImage, gb.goods_spec AS goodsSpec, gc.cat_name AS catName, gb.common_id AS commonId, gc.common_state AS commonState, oc.create_time as createTime FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb ON gb.goods_id = oc.goods_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gc.common_id = gb.common_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og ON og.order_id = oc.order_id and og.goods_id = oc.goods_id where oc.share_user_id = #{param.userId}
and gb.goods_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.goodsName},'%')
and DATE(STR_TO_DATE(oc.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) = DATE(STR_TO_DATE(now(), '%Y-%m-%d')) group by oc.goods_id
order by createTime desc
order by orderCount desc

SELECT a.order_id AS orderId, b.order_create_time AS orderCreateTime, b.order_status AS orderStatus, b.pay_code AS payCode, a.order_status AS orderCommissionStatus, sum(IF(a.tg_one_user_id = #{param.userId}, a.one_tg_commission - a.return_one_tg_commission, 0)) AS oneTgCommission, sum(IF(a.tg_two_user_id = #{param.userId}, a.two_tg_commission - a.return_two_tg_commission, 0)) AS twoTgCommission, sum(IF(a.share_user_id = #{param.userId}, a.fx_commission - a.return_fx_commission, 0)) AS shareCommission, a.buy_user_id AS userId, a.buy_user_name AS userName, a.buy_user_avatar AS userAvatar FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission a LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base b ON a.order_id = b.order_id where a.fx_settlement_status = 1 and a.order_status = 3
and a.order_id like CONCAT('%',#{param.orderId},'%')
and (a.tg_one_user_id = #{param.userId} or a.share_user_id = #{param.userId})
and a.tg_two_user_id = #{param.userId}
and DATE(STR_TO_DATE(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) = DATE(STR_TO_DATE(now(), '%Y-%m-%d'))
and a.create_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
and a.create_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
and a.create_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
and a.create_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
group by a.order_id order by a.create_time desc

SELECT a.order_id AS orderId, b.order_create_time AS orderCreateTime, b.order_status AS orderStatus, b.pay_code AS payCode, a.order_status AS orderCommissionStatus, sum(IF(a.tg_one_user_id = #{param.userId}, a.one_tg_commission - a.return_one_tg_commission, 0)) AS oneTgCommission, sum(IF(a.tg_two_user_id = #{param.userId}, a.two_tg_commission - a.return_two_tg_commission, 0)) AS twoTgCommission, sum(IF(a.share_user_id = #{param.userId}, a.fx_commission - a.return_fx_commission, 0)) AS shareCommission, a.buy_user_id AS userId, a.buy_user_name AS userName, a.buy_user_avatar AS userAvatar FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission a LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base b ON a.order_id = b.order_id where a.fx_settlement_status = 0 and a.order_status in (1,2,4,6)
